root_cause: The legacy P11 oracle sorted observations by descending score and then applied the positive-rank Mann-Whitney AUROC formula whose conventional orientation assumes ascending ranks. This reversed AUROC orientation. Exact score ties were additionally given deterministic key ranks rather than conventional tie averaging.
interpretation: The previous manuscript claim that all held-out AUROC values were below 0.5 and that development-to-held-out AUROC reversed was caused by the P11 metric implementation defect. The frozen scores themselves show above-chance global ranking under conventional AUROC. PU semantics, AP/top-k enrichment results, model fitting, and design-grade rules based on lift remain unchanged.
